system.description:
• The fighting tradition that emerged from the slave pits of the Red Waste — not taught, not codified, discovered through survival. The body adapts when the alternative is death. What comes out of the pits is not elegant, but it is devastating.
  • Pit-Forged Fury: Whirlwind-style: once per encounter, make a primary unarmed attack against up to 3 creatures within 5ft (one roll vs each). Replaces normal attack action.
  • Survivor's Instinct: Advantage on Constitution checks to resist exhaustion, extreme temperatures, and starvation. Advantage on checks to recognise the signs of someone else who survived the pits.
